test.method: Mann-Kendall with autocorrelation correction (lag-1 effective sample size)

notes: 3 of 40 time steps are missing; they were skipped, not filled in.
This is a running total, so a steady change always looks like a strong trend. The slope is the average rate of change; check the rate series to see whether the change is speeding up.
Values close in time are related (autocorrelation), so the test and the interval were made 6.8 times more cautious.
